'''Alkhara's tower''' was the tallest tower of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> It was a nine-story tower named after the criminal [[Alkhara/Legends|Alkhara]], who owned the [[palace]] before [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] and renovated the tower.<ref name="CL 2005" /> It was constructed by the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr monks]] and contained a circular stairway that provided space for the monks to wander, as they could move up and down the stairs while [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The tower was equipped with surveillance technology, a communication dome and a [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|Hyperwave communication system]] which Jabba used to keep up with intrigues in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] underworld.<ref name="CL 2005" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 2005 reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] claims it was Alkhara who added the tower, while ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' establishes that the tower was built by the B'omarr monks who constructed the palace. As both sources claim that Alkhara renovated the tower, it is assumed for this article that it was constructed the B'omarr monks.

In most depictions of Jabba's Palace, Alkhara's tower is the highest point of the palace. In the standalone film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']], a significantly higher tower was added, that didn't exist in the palace's original appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].
